comment: A seventh input, Early Reflection Select Input, is configured at MVerb.cpp:417 but no jack widget was ever added for it, so the hole drawn under the ER knob on the panel takes no cable and the input gets no line. The whole module is monophonic per side. There is a fault in the mesh modulation: MVerb.cpp:441-446 fall through to the 16-24 jack for every mesh point when the 0-15 jack is not connected, and read it at channel k minus 16, which is a negative channel index for the first sixteen points. The mesh frequencies come up at twenty-five fixed values, MVerb.cpp:339-342. This is a port of the MVerb opcode by Jon Christopher Nelson and Michael Gogins, without the per-delay-line equalisers of the original; the maker documents that difference in the README.
